lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Bruna Defrain | Lesson 3 -- Immigration

listenings.text: Welcome to London. This is passport control. Please have your passport in your hand. The officer's questions are short. What is the reason for your trip? How long is your trip? Where is your hotel? Your answers can be short, too. Thank you, and welcome to the United Kingdom.

Hello, Bruna. This is Emma, from the Park Hotel. Welcome to London! Your room is ready. The hotel address is twelve Park Street. It is ten minutes from the station. Your reservation is for seven nights. See you today!

extra_audio.text: Bruna is at passport control in London. The officer asks about the reason for her trip. Bruna says: I am here on vacation. The officer asks: where is your hotel? Bruna says the address: 12 Park Street.

lesson.pre_a1_modelo: I am here on vacation. One week.
lesson.grammar_point: wh- questions with to be (What is...? / Where is...? / How long is...?) + numbers 1-20
